notes: Fresh role sessions receive the full role contract and Orca init preamble. Same-WP continuation uses the bound Codex session as its sole durable index, reacquires the current handle, sends exact instructions, content-addressed delta, gate identity and short role/Control recap, and confirms submission once without repeating MATS init/full contract/full packet or task text.

Every delivery and side request starts as a generated UTF-8 TSV semantic form. Runtime Control-to-Planner requests also use a generated form. Models do not author YAML transaction fields, evidence hashes, snapshots or wrappers.
Planner repair uses the immutable planning occasion and preloads the exact rejected proposal; runtime repair remains sparse patch-only and cannot broaden the design.

Orca restart, handle/PTY replacement, missing agentIdentity and external/user-takeover labels do not replace a session-proved Owner. Native worker-start receives no model/effort override; exact agent_unconfigured has one dispatch --inject fallback. A unique current context_only dispatch is adopted and submitted once without resending text.

TASK_MIGRATION_REQUIRED never starts migration. Only an explicit user instruction permits the read-only migrate validator and then, on invalid state, progressive loading of the manual guide. No product-directory layout is inferred or changed.
Control and leaf prompts prohibit loading the full orchestration guide. orca-cli remains a one-time last syntax fallback only after compaction plus failed exact command help.
R1 needs_synthesis is accepted only with exactly one generated, validated Synthesis request, whose immutable ref is returned mechanically to Control.

All 355 core tests plus 2 independent review protocol invariants passed under Windows Git Bash/uv UTF-8. No live product-domain dispatch or live-project migration was performed by this verification run.
